input.title: Desktop/tablet breakpoints for `MobileCommandUniverse`
input.body: > **Begin expanding `MobileCommandUniverse` into a single, responsive `CommandUniverse` by making the new dialog responsive past the `md` breakpoint.** ## Background The new `MobileCommandUniverse` dialog currently renders at mobile dimensions on every viewport. The goal is for it to grow gracefully past the `md` breakpoint so it can eventually take over from `DesktopCommandUniverse` entirely. This issue outlines the first step: keep the mobile design as-is below `md`, and make the dialog feel right on tablet/desktop. ## Scope - [ ] Past `md`, the dialog grows to fill ~80% of screen width, capped at `max-width: 650px` - [ ] Past `md`, the dialog has `max-height: 560px` - [ ] Past `md`, the title is left-aligned next to the navigation buttons (rather than center-aligned) - [ ] Past `md`, the background glow uses the same image asset, but the visible portion shifts so the right parts of the glow show through on desktop/tablet **Out of scope:** The _content_ of the command universe on desktop – that will be pursued in a later issue. ## Notes - Exact visual parity isn't required — eyeballing spacing/margins is fine. Use `rem`, prefer 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 unit divisions. - Below `md`, behaviour should be unchanged from what's in `main` today.
